models.name: discussion_board_categories
models.description: System reference table defining article categories for the discussion board platform. Provides canonical set of allowed category values (Economics, Politics) that articles must be classified under. This is a system-managed configuration table, not user-created. Categories are used throughout the platform for article organization, filtering, and discovery workflows.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique category code/identifier used throughout the system (e.g., 'economics', 'politics'). This is the programmatic identifier for the category.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable category name displayed to users (e.g., 'Economics', 'Politics'). This is what users see when selecting or filtering by category.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the category explaining its scope and purpose. Helps users understand which category is appropriate for their content.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Numeric ordering value for displaying categories in UI. Lower numbers appear first in lists and navigation menus. Allows flexible category ordering without requiring alphabetical sort.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the category is currently active and available for new article creation. Inactive categories can still be queried for existing articles but are hidden from category selection in UI.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was created or added to the system. Stored in ISO 8601 UTC format for audit trail purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last modified. Updated whenever category metadata changes (name, description, display order, active status).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was soft-deleted (retired from use). Null for active categories. Soft deletion preserves referential integrity - articles can still reference deleted categories for historical accuracy.

models.name: discussion_board_members
models.description: Registered member users who can create articles, post comments, and participate in discussions. Members are authenticated content creators with standard user permissions. Each member maintains a unique email address for authentication and account recovery.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Member's email address used for authentication and account management. Must be unique across all members. Used for login and password recovery workflows.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password using industry-standard algorithms (bcrypt, scrypt, or similar). Never stores plaintext passwords. Required for member authentication during login.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Member account creation timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format. System-generated when member registers. Tracks account age for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp for member account in ISO 8601 UTC format. Updated when account details change (email update, password reset, profile modifications).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for account deactivation. Null means active account. Populated when member deletes account or is deleted by moderators. Enables account recovery and maintains data integrity for historical references.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Current status of the member account: 'active' (normal operation), 'suspended' (temporary access denial, typically 7 days), or 'banned' (permanent access denial). Controls whether member can authenticate and create content.

models.name: discussion_board_member_sessions
models.description: Authentication session records for logged-in members. Tracks active sessions with connection context (IP address, referrer URL). Each session corresponds to a member's login instance. Sessions expire after defined duration (7 days) or when member logs out explicitly. Used for validating JWT tokens and managing user sessions across devices.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member's {@link discussion_board_members.id} who owns this session. Non-nullable and non-unique to allow multiple concurrent sessions per member.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the connection where this session was created. Captured for security auditing and anomaly detection. Used to track login locations.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where member initiated login or authentication. Provides context about member's entry point into the application.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer URL indicating where member came from before logging in. Tracks traffic sources and member navigation patterns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format when member authenticated. System-generated. Used to calculate session age and expiration.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format. Null means session is still active. Set to current time + 7 days on creation, or updated to actual logout time if member explicitly logs out. Null expiry indicates ongoing session.

models.name: discussion_board_moderators
models.description: Administrator/moderator user accounts with elevated permissions for content moderation, user management, and community enforcement. Moderators can review, edit, or remove any content, suspend/ban users, and access moderation dashboards. Separate from members due to distinct permission model and administrative responsibilities.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Moderator's email address used for authentication and administrative account management. Must be unique across all moderators. Used for moderator login and security alerts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password using industry-standard algorithms. Required for moderator authentication. Never stores plaintext passwords for security compliance.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Moderator account creation timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format. System-generated when moderator account is created by administrator. Tracks when moderator access was granted.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp for moderator account in ISO 8601 UTC format. Updated when moderator details change (email update, password reset, permission modifications).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for moderator account deactivation. Null means active moderator account. Populated when moderator access is revoked. Enables recovery and maintains historical reference for moderation actions.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Current status of moderator account: 'active' (performing moderation duties), 'inactive' (access suspended but not revoked), or 'removed' (permanently revoked). Controls whether moderator can authenticate and access admin features.

models.name: discussion_board_moderator_sessions
models.description: Authentication session records for logged-in moderators. Tracks active administrative sessions with connection context (IP, referrer). Each session corresponds to a moderator's login instance. Sessions expire after defined duration or explicit logout. Used for validating moderator JWT tokens and managing admin session lifecycle across sessions.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the moderator's {@link discussion_board_moderators.id} who owns this session. Non-nullable and non-unique to allow multiple concurrent sessions per moderator.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the connection where moderator authenticated. Captured for security audit trail of admin access and to detect unauthorized access attempts.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where moderator initiated login or authentication. Provides context about moderator's entry point into admin interface.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer URL indicating where moderator came from before logging in. Tracks administrative access patterns and traffic sources.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format when moderator authenticated. System-generated. Used to calculate session age and determine expiration.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format. Null means session is still active. Set to current time + 7 days on creation, or updated to actual logout time if moderator explicitly logs out.

models.name: discussion_board_articles
models.description: Primary content articles where members initiate discussions on economic and political topics. Each article contains title, content body, category assignment, and metadata. Articles serve as the primary discussion units and store current state with all edits tracked in separate revision table.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who created the article. Reference to {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category the article belongs to (Economics or Politics). Reference to {@link discussion_board_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title between 3 and 200 characters. Required field that appears in listings and article header.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Main article body text between 10 and 50,000 characters. Contains the substantive discussion content.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current article state: 'published' for visible articles, 'archived' for moderator-hidden articles. Determines visibility to users.

plainFields.name: view_count
plainFields.description: Number of times the article has been viewed. Incremented on each unique user view within 24-hour deduplication window.

plainFields.name: revision_number
plainFields.description: Tracks number of edits made to article. Incremented each time article content is modified. Used for audit trail.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when article was initially created. Set once at creation and never changes even if article is edited.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent modification. Updated whenever article title, content, or other fields change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Set when article is deleted by author or moderator. NULL for active articles. Allows recovery and audit trail.

models.name: discussion_board_article_revisions
models.description: Historical revision records for articles capturing each version. Each edit creates new revision record preserving previous content, editor information, and timestamps. Allows full audit trail and potential rollback to previous versions. Snapshot-based pattern for article change tracking.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Article this revision belongs to. Reference to {@link discussion_board_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: editor_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member or moderator who made the edit. NULL if system edit. Reference to {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: editor_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator who made the edit if applied by moderator. NULL if edit by member. Reference to {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title at time of this revision. Preserves title history across edits.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Article content body at time of this revision. Full historical content preserved immutably.

plainFields.name: edit_type
plainFields.description: Type of edit: 'member_edit' for author edits, 'moderator_edit' for moderator modifications, 'system_update' for automated changes.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Optional reason for moderator edits or system changes. Helps explain why content was modified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this revision was created (when the edit was made).

models.name: discussion_board_comments
models.description: User comments posted on articles enabling threaded discussions. Comments support nested replies through optional parent_comment_id field, allowing members to create discussion threads under articles. Each comment has independent lifecycle, ownership by its author, and can be edited within 24 hours or deleted at any time by the author or moderators.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent article being discussed. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member who authored this comment. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: parent_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent comment if this is a reply. NULL for top-level comments, enabling nested threading up to 3 levels deep.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: The comment text body containing user's discussion contribution. Between 1 and 5,000 characters. Supports basic markdown formatting (bold, italic, links).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the comment. One of: 'published', 'deleted', 'moderated'. Used to track visibility and moderation state of the comment.

plainFields.name: thread_depth
plainFields.description: Nesting level in the discussion thread. 0 for top-level comments, 1+ for replies. Maximum depth is 3 levels (replies to depth 3 attach to depth 3 parent).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created. ISO 8601 format in UTC timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was last modified. Updated when comment text is edited by author or moderators.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was soft-deleted or removed by moderator. NULL if comment is still active. Used to preserve audit trail while hiding content.

plainFields.name: edit_count
plainFields.description: Number of times this comment has been edited by its author. Starts at 0. Incremented each time author modifies the comment. Displayed to users as 'edited' indicator.

models.name: discussion_board_attachments
models.description: Attachment metadata and file references for articles and comments. Supports polymorphic ownership (can attach to articles OR comments). Tracks file metadata, security validation status, and storage information. Separate from content entities to enable independent file management, security scanning, and storage lifecycle. Soft delete support for recovery while hiding from users.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who uploaded the attachment. Reference to {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Article this attachment belongs to if attachable_type is 'article'. NULL if this is a comment attachment. Reference to {@link discussion_board_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Comment this attachment belongs to if attachable_type is 'comment'. NULL if this is an article attachment. Reference to {@link discussion_board_comments.id}.

plainFields.name: attachable_type
plainFields.description: Type of parent content: 'article' or 'comment'. Discriminator indicating which foreign key is active. Validation at application layer ensures this matches the non-NULL FK field.

plainFields.name: filename
plainFields.description: Original filename provided by uploader. Used for display and download. Sanitized to remove path traversal sequences and special characters.

plainFields.name: file_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., 'image/jpeg', 'application/pdf'). Validated during upload against supported types. Used for security classification and display handling.

plainFields.name: file_extension
plainFields.description: File extension without dot (e.g., 'jpg', 'pdf'). Extracted from filename and validated against list of 19 supported extensions. Must match file_type MIME classification.

plainFields.name: file_size
plainFields.description: Size of file in bytes. Validated against limits during upload: images 10MB max, documents 20MB max, archives 50MB max. Stored for audit trail and quota tracking.

plainFields.name: storage_path
plainFields.description: Unique internal path where file is stored on server or cloud storage. UUID or hash-based to guarantee uniqueness. Used for retrieval and deletion. Never exposed to users.

plainFields.name: image_width
plainFields.description: Image width in pixels if attachment is an image file. NULL for non-image types (documents, archives). Extracted during image processing and validation.

plainFields.name: image_height
plainFields.description: Image height in pixels if attachment is an image file. NULL for non-image types. Used for rendering and responsive image handling.

plainFields.name: security_status
plainFields.description: Security validation status: 'pending_scan' (awaiting malware scan), 'safe' (scan passed), 'infected' (malware detected), 'quarantined' (isolated due to violation). Tracks antivirus scan results and security clearance status.

plainFields.name: malware_scan_result
plainFields.description: Detailed result from antivirus/malware scanning if performed. NULL if scan pending or not performed. Contains specific threat information from scanner (e.g., 'detected: trojan.xyz'). Only populated when scan is completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when attachment was uploaded (ISO 8601 UTC). Used for audit trail and storage lifecycle tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when attachment metadata was last updated, especially when security scan results change. Critical for tracking when files became safe or were flagged as threats.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. NULL if attachment is active and visible. Set when attachment is deleted by user or parent content is deleted. Allows recovery and maintains audit trail.

models.name: discussion_board_moderation_logs
models.description: Complete audit trail of all moderation actions taken by moderators including content removal, user suspension, account bans, and other enforcement actions. Every moderator decision is logged with full context for compliance, transparency, and accountability. Supports polymorphic targeting of articles, comments, or user accounts through target_type discriminator pattern.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the moderator who performed this action. {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}.

foreignFields.name: affected_discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member affected by this moderation action (if the action targets a user account, such as suspension or ban). Nullable if action targets content rather than user. {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of moderation action taken. Valid values: 'remove_article', 'remove_comment', 'suspend_user', 'ban_user', 'restore_article', 'restore_comment', 'warning_issued', 'flag_content'. Standardized enumeration ensures consistent action tracking.

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Type of entity targeted by this moderation action. Valid values: 'article', 'comment', 'member'. Used as polymorphic discriminator with target_id to determine the specific entity affected.

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the entity affected by this moderation action. Combined with target_type: if 'article' then references discussion_board_articles.id; if 'comment' then references discussion_board_comments.id; if 'member' then references discussion_board_members.id. Application must validate referential integrity based on target_type.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Moderator-provided reason or explanation for the moderation action (max 500 characters). Documents why the action was taken and what violation occurred. Enables transparent communication with users.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the moderation action was executed. Stored in UTC ISO 8601 format. Used for audit trails and chronological action sequencing.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the moderation log record was last modified. Stored in UTC ISO 8601 format. Used for audit trail tracking of changes.

models.name: discussion_board_user_violations
models.description: Tracks cumulative violations per member for automatic enforcement of community guidelines. Records when users violate policies (spam, harassment, inappropriate content, etc.) and enables automatic account restrictions: 3+ violations in 30 days triggers 7-day suspension, 5+ violations in 90 days triggers permanent ban. Maintains violation history linked to moderation actions for complete audit trail.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member who committed the violation. {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: violation_type
plainFields.description: Category or type of violation committed. Valid values: 'spam', 'harassment', 'inappropriate_content', 'off_topic', 'misinformation', 'copyright_violation', 'illegal_content'. Enables violation categorization and pattern analysis.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Brief description of the specific violation that occurred. Explains what policy was violated and provides context for moderation decisions. Supports compliance documentation and user communication.

plainFields.name: moderation_log_id
plainFields.description: Optional reference to the associated discussion_board_moderation_logs record if this violation triggered a moderation action. {@link discussion_board_moderation_logs.id}. Links violation tracking to enforcement actions for complete audit trail. Nullable if violation is recorded but no action taken yet.

plainFields.name: violation_date
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the violation occurred (when user committed the policy violation). Stored in UTC ISO 8601 format. Used for calculating 30-day and 90-day violation windows that trigger automatic suspension and banning. Critical for time-based enforcement thresholds.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this violation record was created in the system. Stored in UTC ISO 8601 format. May differ from violation_date if violation is recorded after the fact. Used for audit trail tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this violation record was last modified. Stored in UTC ISO 8601 format. Used for audit trail tracking of violation record changes.

models.name: discussion_board_notifications
models.description: Notifications informing users of relevant events such as comment replies, mentions, and moderation actions. Each notification represents a discrete event requiring user awareness. Notifications support independent user workflows including browsing, marking as read, and deletion. Users can view their personal notification inbox independently of source content. Enhanced to support email delivery tracking, duplicate prevention, and proper audit trails.

foreignFields.name: recipient_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member who is the recipient of this notification. The member who should be informed of the event. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: triggering_article_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the article that triggered this notification if applicable. Used when notification is about article comments, article moderation, etc. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: triggering_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the comment that triggered this notification if applicable. Used when notification is about comment replies or comment moderation. {@link discussion_board_comments.id}

foreignFields.name: source_member_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the member who caused this notification if applicable. The user who commented, mentioned, or triggered the event. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: notification_type
plainFields.description: Type of notification event. Valid values: 'comment_reply' (someone replied to user's comment), 'mention' (user was mentioned in comment), 'article_moderation' (user's article was moderated/removed), 'comment_moderation' (user's comment was moderated/removed). Categorizes what event triggered this notification for filtering and display purposes. Should be constrained to enum values at database level.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short title/subject of the notification for display in notification lists. Examples: 'New reply to your comment', 'Your article was removed', 'You were mentioned'. Keep brief (50-100 characters) for quick scanning.

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Full notification message body providing context about the event. Includes details about what happened, who it was from (if applicable), and relevant article/comment information. Supports markdown or plain text (200-500 characters typical).

plainFields.name: is_read
plainFields.description: Whether the user has read/viewed this notification. False indicates unread notification that should be highlighted in user's notification inbox. Used for visual distinction and unread count calculations.

plainFields.name: read_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user read/viewed this notification. Null if notification has not been read yet (is_read = false). Used for tracking when users engage with notifications and for sorting by recency.

plainFields.name: action_url
plainFields.description: Optional URL or deep link to navigate directly to the related content when notification is clicked. Examples: '/articles/[articleId]#comment-[commentId]' or '/articles/[articleId]'. Null for notifications without a direct action target.

plainFields.name: email_sent_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this notification was sent via email to the recipient. Null if notification has not been emailed yet or user has email notifications disabled. Used to track which notifications have been delivered via email for compliance and retry logic.

plainFields.name: email_failed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when email delivery for this notification failed. Null if email sent successfully or notification not sent via email. Used to track failed deliveries for retry and debugging purposes.

plainFields.name: email_send_error
plainFields.description: Error message or reason code if email delivery failed. Null if email sent successfully. Examples: 'SMTP_TIMEOUT', 'INVALID_ADDRESS', 'BOUNCE'. Enables troubleshooting of delivery failures.

plainFields.name: recipient_email
plainFields.description: Email address of the recipient member at time of notification creation. Denormalized from member record for efficient email delivery. Null if member has no email or delivery disabled. Allows sending emails even if member record is updated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this notification was created/generated in UTC ISO 8601 format. Marks when the triggering event occurred. Used for sorting notifications chronologically (newest first) and for cleanup policies. System-generated, immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this notification record was last modified in UTC ISO 8601 format. Updated when notification status changes (marked read, email sent, etc.). Used for audit trail and tracking notification lifecycle changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this notification was deleted/archived by the user in UTC ISO 8601 format. Null indicates active notification. Used for soft deletion allowing recovery and maintains audit trail of user actions on notifications.
